actions: Reuse icon-work/bookmark-check; do not rerun prepare or overwrite the existing request and revision.
Read the frozen request, pinned revision, drawing reference and sibling drawings; inspect available sibling previews.
Use two independent authors in separate candidate directories, then run the installed CLI checker and inspect native and enlarged light/dark proofs.
Obtain two fresh independent reviews using anonymous shuffled images, recording free recognition before revealing the request.
Retain versions and hash-linked reviews through at most three visual repair rounds per candidate.
Deliver qualifying SVG, DSL and inspected proofs in selected/ with review.md; otherwise deliver retained drafts with blockers.
acceptance: Exact replay, no structural errors and all warnings resolved.
Both reviewers confirm bookmark and check, score at least 9, accept unchanged and report no critical defect or uncertainty.
Keep craftApproved false; do not claim pipeline-wide qualification.
